inputs.prompt:
Translate these narration lines:
{
 "s01": "Every family has a beginning. Ours begins at the old walls of Harar.",
 "s02": "My great-grandparents came here as strangers, carrying little more than a skill.",
 "s03": "They were tailors. Stitch by stitch, they built a life with their hands.",
 "s04": "Their children became merchants. The stitches became trade, and the trade became a living.",
 "s05": "What they earned, they saved, for the ones who would come after them.",
 "s06": "My mother worked in the market by day, and carried her schoolbooks with her.",
 "s07": "At night, when she was tired, she studied anyway.",
 "s08": "And one day, she graduated.",
 "s09": "Then she worked long hours in an office, and gave everything she had so that I could learn.",
 "s10": "I graduated in software engineering, with honours. Today, I work on artificial intelligence.",
 "s11": "Nothing I have is mine alone. It is the work of everyone who came before me. Now it is my turn to take us a little further."
}
inputs.system: You translate documentary film narration for voice-over. Write natural, spoken Amharic in its native script (no transliteration), for a young woman narrating in the first person about her own family. Use short sentences written for the ear, warm and simple, never bureaucratic. Keep the meaning of each line exactly; do not add facts, names, places or dates. Keep 'Harar' as the city name. Return only a JSON object mapping each line id to its translation.
